properties.name: kraken.messaging.service-name
properties.description: Logical service name: Kafka consumer group, event source and hub registration name. Required.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.type-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of the wire type name of message classes without @MessageType. Required.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.enabled
properties.description: Connect to the hub and expose the hub-backed CommandBus and QueryBus.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.address
properties.description: The hub or hubs: one gRPC target (host:port, optional static:// prefix), a comma-separated list of them (one connection per hub), or one dns:///name:port re-resolved every 30 s.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.status-interval
properties.description: Period of the InstanceStatus report sent to every hub whose RegisterAck lists the instance-status capability (must be positive).

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.request-timeout
properties.description: Per-request timeout sent as timeout_ms. Unset: a protocol v2 hub applies its default or per-type override, a legacy hub gets 5s. 0s counts as unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: Fallback heartbeat period, used only when the hub does not announce one in its RegisterAck (legacy hubs).

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.reconnect-backoff.min
properties.description: Initial reconnect delay when the hub stream drops; doubles per failed attempt, resets once an attempt reached the hub's handshake.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.reconnect-backoff.max
properties.description: Maximum reconnect delay when the hub stream drops; every wait is jittered by +-20 % and capped at this value (at the cap: 80-100 % of it).

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.stream-credit-timeout
properties.description: Longest a streaming handler waits for credit from the collector before it ends the stream with TIMEOUT and frees its handler slot and hub permit. Must be positive; the default is the hub's default maximum stream duration.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.max-subscriptions
properties.description: Subscription queries this instance serves at once, over every hub (at least 1); the next one is refused with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. A subscription holds no handler permit, so max-concurrent-handlers does not bound it.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.token
properties.description: Static token sent in Register.credentials.token of every hub stream (hub access control, P5a). Optional; empty is the same as none. Never logged and redacted in toString and in the actuator configprops and env output. Environment variable KRAKEN_MESSAGING_HUB_TOKEN, or KRAKEN_HUB_TOKEN when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.token-file
properties.description: File holding the hub token (a container secret): read at startup, where an unreadable file fails the startup, and again on every reconnect. Wins over kraken.messaging.hub.token when both are set. Environment variable KRAKEN_MESSAGING_HUB_TOKEN_FILE, or KRAKEN_HUB_TOKEN_FILE when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.oauth2.token-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (Keycloak: https://<host>/realms/<realm>/protocol/openid-connect/token). Setting it turns Keycloak client-credentials authentication on (P5b, ADR 0019): the service registers with the access token as a jwt credential and renews it before it expires. http is allowed and warns unless the host is loopback or a single-label name. Cannot be combined with hub.token or hub.token-file. Environment variable KRAKEN_MESSAGING_HUB_OAUTH2_TOKEN_URI, or KRAKEN_HUB_OAUTH2_TOKEN_URI when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.oauth2.client-id
properties.description: The confidential client's id, which is the azp of its tokens and must be the service name. Defaults to kraken.messaging.service-name. Environment variable KRAKEN_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.oauth2.client-secret
properties.description: The client secret. Never logged and redacted in toString and in the actuator configprops and env output; prefer client-secret-file. Environment variable KRAKEN_MESSAGING_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET, or KRAKEN_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.oauth2.client-secret-file
properties.description: File holding the client secret (a container secret): read at startup, where an unreadable file fails the startup, and again on every token fetch, so a rotated secret applies without a restart. Wins over client-secret. Environment variable KRAKEN_MESSAGING_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE, or KRAKEN_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.oauth2.scope
properties.description: scope of the token request, as sent (space-separated); none by default. Environment variable KRAKEN_HUB_OAUTH2_SCOPE when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.oauth2.ca-file
properties.description: PEM file with CA certificates to trust on top of the platform roots for an https token-uri (not the hub's CA: that is hub.tls.ca-file). Environment variable KRAKEN_HUB_OAUTH2_CA when this property is unset.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.tls.enabled
properties.description: Talk TLS to the hub, for every address form (static list and dns:///). Off: plain text.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.tls.ca-file
properties.description: PEM file with the CA certificate(s) that signed the hub's certificate; the JVM's system roots when absent. Read on every connection attempt.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.tls.server-name
properties.description: Name the hub's certificate is verified against instead of the address's host.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.max-concurrent-handlers
properties.description: Incoming hub requests handled concurrently by this instance; further requests wait for a free slot. Also announced as initial_permits to a hub with flow control, which queues the excess.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.load-factor
properties.description: Relative capacity of this instance (Register.load_factor, 100 = normal); weights its share of the hub's routing.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.tags
properties.description: Labels announced in Register.tags, for example zone=eu-1; unkeyed requests prefer instances whose tags match the sender's.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.priorities
properties.description: Default Request.priority per message type name (types not listed send 0); higher is served first when the hub queues requests.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.retry.enabled
properties.description: Retry failed sends that are safe to retry (see RetryClassification).

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Total attempts including the first.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.retry.initial-backoff
properties.description: Wait before the second attempt.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Growth of the wait per further attempt.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.hub.retry.max-backoff
properties.description: Upper bound of a single wait; all attempts stay within the caller's timeout budget.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Kafka bootstrap servers.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.kafka.topic
properties.description: Events topic.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.kafka.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Consume the events topic; set false in tools that only publish.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.kafka.consumer.max-attempts
properties.description: Handler invocations per record (first try included) before the record is logged and skipped.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Run the outbox publisher that relays the outbox collection to Kafka.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.outbox.poll-interval
properties.description: Outbox publisher poll period.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Outbox documents per poll.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.outbox.retention
properties.description: Sent outbox documents older than this are deleted.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.outbox.max-attempts
properties.description: Send attempts per outbox document before it is marked failed (failedAt) and skipped.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.idempotency.retention
properties.description: processed_events documents older than this are deleted.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.security.forward-jwt
properties.description: Put the current request's bearer token in the hub request's authorization header.
